title: Italian Baroque
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Italian Baroque", at revision 1365974658, opens: "Italian Baroque is a stylistic period in Italian history and art that spanned from the late 16th century to the early 18th century." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q13581485, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "movement in art and architecture". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
